answer: Mechanism: karst escrow - each identity stakes capital that drains a fixed fraction per epoch and refills only by passing work audits. Reward weight flows along a trellis of attestation edges between escrowed nodes, each capped by its own live balance. Fielding N puppets costs N full stakes, each draining and audited, no bulk discount; an honest user refills one. Funds traced to one origin lagoon are jointly forfeited on-chain, so splitting or resetting accounts cannot amortize cost; the escrow is the binding variable, unusable until repaid. Attacker cost grows linearly with n.
